# Community Safety Trust — Risk Register (extract)

The Community Safety Trust supports the members and institutions of Community X in the city of Northfield. This register lists the risks and goals the Trust's analysts monitor.

Risk R1: Hateful radicals plan a violent attack on members of Community X. Individuals or small groups hostile to the community may prepare an attack on members, their homes, or community institutions such as the Community Centre or the Place of Worship.

Risk R2: Burglary of homes in the Riverside neighbourhood. Opportunistic or organised offenders scout residential homes in Riverside for theft.

Risk R3: Harassment of community members online. Coordinated abuse directed at named members through social platforms.

Risk R4: Vandalism of community institutions. Damage to the Community Centre, the Place of Worship, or the Northfield Community School.

Goal G1: Grow attendance at community events. The Trust aims to increase participation in its programme at the Community Centre.
